intent.text: ses: The three of us now agree on the substance. The one gap in my motion is that it lets the rule stay machine-wide while the tests are still outstanding. Sec's interim fixes that, so I would amend my motion to adopt it: take the rule out of the global ~/.claude/settings.json now, keep the attribution hook itself, run the compound-form and quoting tests (';', '&&', '||', newline, '|', backtick, ${}), and only then re-add a narrowed rule in project or hook-scoped settings. Until that scoped rule exists, a refused export should fail loudly, not run unattributed. If the tests fail, the rule stays out and agents take the prompt. I would put that amended text to Joseph as the single recommendation. I will pass on further debate unless someone raises a new point.
